**Calendar Event Updated**
- [Google Calendar](https://www.google.com/calendar/event?eid=MDJjdTFiMWcxbXNjdW52N2QzcDBpbGczZ2dfMjAyNTA2MTlUMTQwMDAwWiBjX3VwYW9mb25nOG1ncm1ya2VnbjdpYzdoazVzQGc)
- Skipping email notification (already processed issue #1569 before).

**Telegram Notification**
- Updated message for this occurrence to Ethereum Protocol Updates channel

While not something I'd like to add the agenda, could some of the core dev teams look at [EIP-7932](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7932) async? I tried to design it to be as easy as possible to implement, but I would like reviews from people who understand the core execution logic.

During berlin interop we discussed:

https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9892

this does not require an HF and can be done in parallel to Fusaka. this allows us to make receipts not a problem up to 110MN of gas/block

EDIT there is a better alternative: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9906
At the Berlin interop I heard that [EIP-7907](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7907) is bad for zkEVM. Shall we exclude it from Fusaka perhaps?

I would like to add an introduction of EIP-7745 (trustless log index) to the agenda. I do not intend to go into technical details, just give a quick overview of the ongoing efforts, some numbers i already have and what it would mean in general for ux and the core protocol.
https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7745

Also, since Etan also intends to mention it as something that fits into the Pureth concept, we discussed that if we both present at the same acd then i should probably go first if possible

I wrote down some considerations for the BLOB_BASE_COST constant in EIP-7918, which can be helpful if the topic is discussed today:

https://notes.ethereum.org/@anderselowsson/BLOB_BASE_COST
we should discuss the max blob limit per transaction value we want to use in fusaka
I also want to add EOF to the Glamsterdam agenda and I'll briefly give my perspective of EOF.
